value.rationale: The first harmonic is the simplest nonconstant positive definite circle input; third output harmonic is provably the earliest permitted failure under symmetric monotone sampling. The theorem establishes a new all-degree sign threshold and order-one persistent defect, relevant to choosing nonlinear sampling nodes beyond low-degree catalogues.
